elements.label: Figure 2.15
elements.title: Import Source Diversity and External Debt Burdens, by Food Group, Income Group, and Population, 2025

axes.x: External debt stocks as share of exports (%, log scale)

legend: Population, 2025 (bubble size): 5 million, 25 million, 100 million, 500 million, 1,000 million
elements.description: Four bubble scatter plots for 2025 show import source diversity against external debt stocks relative to exports: a. Starchy staples, b. Oils and fats, c. Legumes, nuts, and seeds, and d. Animal-source foods. Bubble color represents income group and bubble size represents population. Fitted lines slope downward for starchy staples and animal-source foods and upward for oils and fats and legumes, nuts, and seeds. Each panel also has a shaded band around the fitted line and a vertical dashed line.
